name: Baked Cheese Bread Flower
subtitle: Rosemary dough petals with cranberry and warm cheese
description: A pull-apart pizza-dough centerpiece arranged around baked camembert or chaource, with rosemary butter and cranberry sauce.

ingredients.item: bunch rosemary sprigs leaves picked and chopped
ready-made pizza dough defrosted if necessary (we used The Northern Dough Co)
box camembert or chaource (or vegetarian alternative)

instructions.text: Mix the softened butter with the chopped rosemary. Set aside a few rosemary sprigs for decoration.
Dust the work surface with flour. Divide the dough into portions and shape them into small balls.
Arrange the dough balls in a flower shape around the cheese, leaving the center open. Cover and let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
Spread or brush the rosemary butter over the dough, then add the cranberry sauce as directed by the arrangement, keeping the cheese area clear.
Place the cheese in the center, add the reserved rosemary sprigs, and drizzle the dough and cheese lightly with oil.
Preheat the oven according to the pizza dough or cheese package directions. Bake for about 40 minutes, until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is hot and softened.
Let the bread cool for 5 minutes before serving.
